notes.title: Some more fun stuff
notes.content:
Here's a quick list of what's new:

Rocky Desert Map
New Settings Menu

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41071387/c52690d86c10633c2c7fd761fcbef7a43e736679.png
Poly Racing's Team has grown a bit, so there will be even more fun stuff soon, and we'll be releasing a roadmap soon of the massive features we want to add, like career mode and multiplayer, and we will also be discussing Steam Deck compatibility and Unreal Engine 5 with our players over on our Discord server today! You'll also be seeing the Steam store page art and graphics change to reflect the new look.

notes.title: Bigger Maps!
notes.content:
We've been working hard for a while on some different aspects of Poly Racing, and were happy to release some new big maps to explore! In this update there are two new maps as well as some performance gains.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41071387/b339962171996a2b4643e48e11d8d03978a158a1.png

New stuff:

2 New Maps
Performance Improvements

We have some big things coming for Poly Racing, and are really excited to share them with you in the near future!
